Name: Inches To Metric System
Author: Lombus
Description:
As someone who's used to the metric system, it always annoyed me that when fishing I had no idea what was the real size of the fishes.
Conversions to the metric system were actually made in several of the localisations, but unfortunately, they didn't add this option in the English version, and thus this mod was born!

Inches To Metric System uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to convert the measurements of the game to the metric system when playing in English.

Included changes:
[list]
[*]All fishes have their size shown in centimetres instead of inches (technically should work with modded fish, but I haven't tested);
[*]The roadway sign in the intro displays the distance in meters;
[*]Dialogues and TV weather reports will use the metric system.
[/list]
Let me know if you find any bugs, or if there's any other mention of inches/miles somewhere in the game.


[b]Installation/Setup:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043][/url]﻿.
[*]Place this mod in Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*][b][NEW in version 2.0.0] In the main menu of the game, click on the "Languages" icon (bubble in lower right corner of the screen) and select the custom "English" (accessible by clicking the arrow in the menu to see the right panel). It should look like in the image below.[/b]
[*][Optional]: If you want to have the clock in 24H format check this mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20794]here[/url]﻿.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Prgn7xU.png[/img]﻿[b]
Compatibility:
[/b]It should work in any version of the game and with any mod as long as they don't replace the same lines/assets.


[b]Important Note: [/b]If you use have a save where my mod was active and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20794]24H Clock Language[/url]﻿ or change the game to an European language (e.g. Spanish or French) the recorded fish will have 3x the size. Use this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39657]converter [/url]to correct the caught fish sizes.


Special thanks to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/2714323-danialbrtsances/]DaniAlbrtSancEs[/url] for helping me update the mod a while back![b] [/b]As well as [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/PinkSerenity]PinkSerenity[/url] that helped improving compatibility with other mods and languages, as well as creating a converter to fix the fish sizes when updating to new versions of the mod.

[b]
Enjoy the mod and have fun! 😉[/b]
